changelog.body:
# XTQ 12.23.1-prod.01

## 更新内容

- **浏览历史**：侧栏入口随 X 的界面语言显示，继续支持本地记录、重新打开和清空。
- **X 版本适配**：主要适配并实机验证 X `12.23.1-prod.01`。
- **自动翻译**：改进帖子、短帖和回复的自动翻译触发，保留原文；目标语言默认跟随 X，也可单独指定。改善刷新后的处理顺序，跳过空白、纯链接等没有可翻译正文的内容。
- **图片与视频**：图片保存按钮和视频／GIF 下载接管分别控制；关闭 XTQ 图片按钮后，X 原生图片保存仍可用。完善保存过程和结果提示。
- **视频播放**：新增独立的“不自动跳到下一个视频”选项，默认关闭；手动切换和现有横向轮播选项保持独立。
- **广告过滤**：补全帖子详情回复模块中的推广内容过滤，保留普通回复。
- **设置界面**：分组卡片支持展开、收起，调整后自动保存，并完善中英文文案。
- **功能保留**：本次没有删除上一公开版本已提供的功能。

## What's Changed

- **Browsing history**: The sidebar entry follows X's interface language, while local recording, reopening, and clearing remain available.
- **X compatibility**: Primarily targets X `12.23.1-prod.01`, verified on a real device.
- **Automatic translation**: Improves triggering for posts, short posts, and replies while preserving the original text. The target language follows X by default or can be selected separately. Improves processing after refresh and skips content with no translatable body, such as blank or link-only posts.
- **Images and videos**: Image-save buttons and video/GIF download takeover have separate controls. X's native image saving remains available when XTQ's image buttons are off. Improves save-progress and result messages.
- **Video playback**: Adds a separate “Do not automatically move to the next video” option, off by default. Manual switching and the existing horizontal-carousel option remain independent.
- **Ad filtering**: Extends promoted-content filtering to reply modules in post details while preserving ordinary replies.
- **Settings**: Grouped cards can expand or collapse, changes save automatically, and Chinese/English wording is improved.
- **Preserved features**: No features from the previous public release were removed in this update.

## 版本信息

- XTQ：`versionCode 26` / `versionName 12.23.1-prod.01`。
- 已验证的 X：`12.23.1-prod.01`；其他 X 版本未在本次重新验证。
- APK：`XTQ-26-12.23.1-prod.01.apk`，1,735,203 字节。


这次适配和修复花了我不少时间：重新分析新版 X 的变化，处理翻译、媒体和广告过滤的细节，再逐项进行实机验证。如果 XTQ 帮你找回了看过的帖子、读懂了外语内容，或让保存媒体更方便，欢迎给[项目点一颗 Star](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.tianqianguai.xtq)。

**每一颗 Star 都是对我的鼓励，也是我继续跟进新版 X、维护 XTQ 的动力。**

# XTQ 12.21.1-prod.05

## 更新内容

- **浏览历史**：继续提供 X 内私有浏览历史，仅记录用户明确打开的帖子、视频或 GIF，支持重新打开与清空，不上传数据。
- **X 12.21.1 适配**：完成 X `12.21.1-prod.05` 的链接、媒体、过滤、浏览历史与翻译目标适配。
- **原生翻译增强**：复用 X 原生翻译自动处理符合条件的短帖，在自动结果中保留原文，并保持手动翻译路径不变。
- **原图与媒体下载**：图片查看页新增“保存原图”和多图“全部保存”；视频与 GIF 下载继续优先使用非 HLS 最高码率直链。
- **内容与媒体选项**：继续提供推广内容过滤、敏感媒体显示和高质量视频等选项。
- **界面**：启用新的 XTQ 桌面图标。
- **精简**：移除不受支持的投票结果增强和媒体 URL 复制操作。

## What's Changed

- **Browsing history**: Continues to provide private browsing history inside X. It records only posts, videos, or GIFs explicitly opened by the user, supports reopening and clearing entries, and uploads no data.
- **X 12.21.1 compatibility**: Adapts link, media, filtering, browsing-history, and translation targets for X `12.21.1-prod.05`.
- **Native translation enhancements**: Reuses X's native translation flow to automatically translate eligible short posts, preserves the original text in automatic results, and leaves manual translation unchanged.
- **Original images and media downloads**: Adds “Save original” and multi-image “Save all” actions to the image viewer; video and GIF downloads continue to prefer the highest-bitrate non-HLS direct variant.
- **Content and media options**: Continues to provide promoted-content filtering, sensitive-media display, high-quality video, and related options.
- **Interface**: Enables the new XTQ launcher icon.
- **Cleanup**: Removes the unsupported poll-result enhancement and media URL-copy actions.

## 发布信息

- `versionCode 20` / `versionName 12.21.1-prod.05`。
- 版本名直接对应主要适配的 X 版本，方便一眼识别。

## Release Information

- `versionCode 20` / `versionName 12.21.1-prod.05`.
- The version name directly matches the primary X compatibility target for immediate identification.

## ⭐ 支持 XTQ

适配新版 X 并不是简单地改一个版本号。X 每次更新都可能调整内部实现和接口结构；为了让浏览历史、媒体、过滤和翻译等功能继续稳定工作，我需要重新分析新版、逐项校验功能、反复构建候选包，并在真实设备上完成回归。

这个版本投入了很多时间去定位兼容变化、修复细节和验证发布包。如果 XTQ 确实帮到了你，欢迎给项目点一颗 [Star ⭐](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.tianqianguai.xtq)。每一颗 Star 都是对我的鼓励，也会成为我继续跟进新版 X、维护兼容性的动力。谢谢你的支持！

## ⭐ Support XTQ

Adapting XTQ to a new X release takes much more than changing a version number. Each X update can alter internal implementations and interface structures. Keeping browsing history, media, filtering, translation, and the other features working reliably requires analyzing the new app again, validating each feature, building repeated candidates, and completing regression tests on a real device.

A great deal of time went into tracing compatibility changes, fixing details, and validating this release. If XTQ is genuinely useful to you, please consider giving the project a [Star ⭐](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.tianqianguai.xtq). Every Star is meaningful encouragement and motivates me to keep up with new X versions and maintain compatibility. Thank you for your support!

XTQ

面向 X Android（com.twitter.android）的 LSPosed/Xposed 增强模块
An LSPosed/Xposed enhancement module for X Android

如果 XTQ 对你有帮助，欢迎点一个 Star。每一颗 Star 都是对我的鼓励 ⭐

当前公开版本：`12.33.0-prod.01`（versionCode 62）。
Current public release: `12.33.0-prod.01` (versionCode 62). 主要适配版本：X `12.33.0-prod.01`（`312330001`）。
Primary supported X version: `12.33.0-prod.01` (`312330001`). ## 本版更新 / This release - 修复浏览历史点击后先返回首页、长时间等待才打开帖子的问题，现可直接进入帖子详情。
Fixes history entries returning to Home and taking too long to open; entries now open post details directly. - 适配 X 12.33.0-prod.01，恢复浏览历史、自动翻译、原图保存、视频下载、最高画质、停止自动连播及广告过滤的新版兼容性。
Supports X 12.33.0-prod.01, restoring browsing history, automatic translation, original-image saving, video downloads, highest-quality playback, stop-auto-advance and ad filtering for this version. ## 功能 / Features - **浏览历史**：在 X 内注入的侧边栏浏览历史，仅记录用户明确打开的帖子、视频或 GIF；不会记录滚动曝光、自动播放或仅查看图片。历史仅保留在本机并保持私密，支持全文搜索、重新打开记录和清空历史，不上传任何数据；列表按可见内容加载，减少打开等待。旧版截断记录需再次浏览后补全正文。
**Browsing history**: Injected inside X's sidebar, local browsing history records only posts, videos, or GIFs that the user explicitly opens; it does not record scroll exposure, autoplay, or image-only viewing. History stays local and private, supports full-text search, reopening entries and clearing history, and uploads no data. Visible rows are loaded as needed to reduce opening delays. Revisit older truncated entries to fill in their full text. - **链接净化**：净化剪贴板、分享和应用内跳转中的 X 链接跟踪参数，并支持选择或配置分享域名。
**Link cleanup**: Cleans tracking parameters from X links copied, shared, or opened in the app, with selectable and configurable share domains. - **原图与媒体下载**：图片查看页提供“保存原图”和多图“全部保存”，图片按钮与视频/GIF 下载接管分别控制；XTQ 管理的图片保存使用自定义目录和命名，默认配置保留 X 原生图片保存行为。视频与 GIF 下载优先选择非 HLS 最高码率直链；开启视频接管时，为原生隐藏下载项且有有效下载文件的视频补出入口。
**Original images and media downloads**: Adds “Save original” and multi-image “Save all” actions, with separate controls for image buttons and video/GIF download takeover. Images saved through XTQ use its custom folders and filenames; default settings retain X's native image saving. Video and GIF downloads prefer the highest-bitrate non-HLS direct variant. With takeover enabled, eligible videos with a supported file gain a download action even when the native menu hides it. - **原生翻译增强**：复用 X 原生翻译自动处理符合条件的短帖和回复，在自动翻译结果中保留原文；目标语言默认跟随 X，也可明确选择固定语言。空正文会跳过，待处理内容会及时刷新，手动翻译路径保持不变。
**Native translation enhancements**: Reuses X's native translation flow to automatically translate eligible short posts and replies while preserving the original text; the target follows X by default or can be set explicitly. Empty bodies are skipped and pending work is refreshed promptly; manual translation remains unchanged. - **内容过滤**：隐藏推广内容、推广用户、视频轮播、资料推荐和横幅；广告帖子过滤覆盖帖子详情中的嵌套模块。
**Content filtering**: Hides promoted content, promoted users, video carousels, profile recommendations, and banners; promoted-post filtering also covers nested modules in post details. - **视频播放控制**：可选关闭视频播放结束后自动进入下一个视频；该选项与帖子内横向轮播独立，仍可手动切换，默认关闭。
**Video playback control**: Optionally stops automatic movement to the next video after playback; this is independent of the in-post horizontal carousel, and videos remain switchable manually. It is off by default. - **媒体显示选项**：提供敏感媒体显示和高质量视频选项。
**Media display options**: Provides sensitive-media display and high-quality video options. - **设置与反馈**：设置按类别分组并支持展开或收起，调整会自动保存并显示保存反馈；浏览历史入口随 X 语言本地化。
**Settings and feedback**: Groups settings into collapsible categories, saves changes automatically with save feedback, and localizes the browsing-history entry to X's language. - **桌面图标**：可选隐藏 XTQ 的系统桌面图标；仍可从 LSPosed 模块管理中打开 XTQ 设置，默认显示。
**Launcher icon**: Optionally hides the XTQ icon from the system launcher; XTQ settings remain available from the LSPosed module manager, and the icon is shown by default. - **动态适配与兼容性回退**：功能开关、媒体字段、帖子和作者读取支持经过校验的动态识别与缓存回退；不匹配时保留 X 原生行为。此能力不代表所有功能或未来 X 版本均能自动兼容。
**Dynamic adaptation and fallback**: Validated discovery and cached fallback for feature switches, media fields, and post/author readers; unmatched targets preserve X's native behavior. This does not guarantee automatic compatibility for every feature or future X version. - **配置迁移**：支持 JSON 设置导入与导出，不导出浏览历史。
**Settings transfer**: Imports and exports settings as JSON without browsing history. - **下载命名**：提供账号名、昵称、用户 ID、帖子 ID 及时间戳等命名格式，也支持“账号名_时间戳”和自定义模板；单媒体不加多余序号，多媒体保留序号。
**Download filenames**: Offers naming formats using usernames, display names, user IDs, post IDs, or timestamps, including username_timestamp and custom templates; single-media files omit an unnecessary sequence suffix and multiple files retain their sequence numbers. - **自动刷新控制**：可保留重启或返回首页时的缓存内容，手动刷新和无缓存加载保持可用，默认关闭。
**Automatic refresh control**: Can retain cached Home content across restarts and returns; manual refresh and loading without a cache remain available. Off by default. - **首页直播空间栏**：可选隐藏首页直播与 Spaces 栏，空间功能和其他入口保留，默认关闭。
**Home live and Spaces bar**: Optionally hides the Home bar while preserving Spaces and other entry points. Off by default. - **Re:X 共存**：可选“优先使用 Re:X”，默认关闭；让出指定重叠功能并隐藏对应设置，原设置值仍保留。浏览历史、翻译、XTQ 图片保存、最高画质和停止自动连播仍由 XTQ 控制。Re:X 视频下载的目录与命名由 Re:X 配置；此选项不会自动启用 Re:X 或修改其配置。
**Re:X coexistence**: Optional “Prefer Re:X” mode is off by default. It yields selected overlapping features and hides their controls while preserving saved values. Browsing history, translation, XTQ image saving, highest-quality playback and stop-auto-advance remain under XTQ control. Re:X manages its own video download folders and filenames; this option does not enable Re:X or modify its configuration. - **社区与更新**：设置内提供项目主页、交流群和发布频道入口。
**Community and updates**: Settings link to the project, community group and release channel. - **问题反馈**：诊断信息增加卡顿、翻译和下载阶段的耗时，帮助定位异常。
**Problem reports**: Diagnostics include performance, translation and download-stage timings to help locate issues. ## 兼容性 / Compatibility - 本版主要适配 X 12.33.0-prod.01；其他版本的兼容记录请参阅对应历史 Release。
This release targets X 12.33.0-prod.01; see the corresponding past releases for other-version compatibility records. 每次 X 更新后，我都需要分析变化、构建候选并进行实机验证。
After each X update, I analyze changes, build candidates, and test on real devices. 如果 XTQ 对你有帮助，欢迎给项目一个 Star。每一颗 Star 都是对我的鼓励。
